github_copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
github_copilot.description: Microsoft-backed AI code completion integrated with GitHub and VS Code
github_copilot.features: IDE autocomplete, function-level completion, Copilot Chat (refactoring, testing, explanations), GitHub PR summaries, context window up to 20K tokens
github_copilot.architecture: Cloud-based, LLM-powered (GPT-4 backend), VS Code native, GitHub Actions integration
github_copilot.adoption: 50M+ monthly active users (VS Code marketplace), dominates mindshare, enterprise standard ($10-39/mo)
github_copilot.compliance: SOC 2, GDPR support, enterprise SSO, IP indemnity (enterprise tier)
github_copilot.integrations: VS Code, JetBrains, GitHub, Neovim, GitHub Actions
github_copilot.dx: Reliable, boring, consistent performance, good documentation, 25-35% faster routine tasks, struggles with domain logic
github_copilot.community_health: Strong; backed by Microsoft, regular updates, large community
github_copilot.notes: Market leader; Toyota Camry of AI assistants (reliable, not surprising)

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.description: IDE reimagined around AI-first workflows with deep codebase context
cursor.features: Cmd+K inline code editing, codebase-wide context (repo indexing), natural language code modification, VS Code fork
cursor.architecture: Local + cloud hybrid, builds on VS Code foundation, repo indexing engine
cursor.adoption: 1M+ downloads, popular with power users and startups, fast growth ($20/mo Pro)
cursor.compliance: No enterprise tier yet; limited for regulated industries
cursor.integrations: VS Code-based, weaker CI integration support
cursor.dx: Transformative 'flow state' effect; cuts PR review time by 30%; over-reliance risk for junior devs
cursor.extensibility: Moderate; VS Code fork allows customization
cursor.notes: IDE reimagination narrative; best for fast-moving startups and senior developers

codeium.name: Codeium / Windsurf
codeium.description: Open-source alternative to Copilot with broad language support
codeium.features: 70+ language support (including COBOL, Fortran), free tier, Supercomplete multi-line prediction, codebase search, Teams tier $12/mo
codeium.architecture: Cloud-based, optimized for polyglot environments, open-source friendly
codeium.adoption: Free tier enables broad adoption; strong in enterprise with budget constraints
codeium.integrations: Broad IDE support (70+ languages), VS Code, JetBrains
codeium.dx: 15-20% lower acceptance rate vs Copilot, but superior language coverage; good for legacy systems
codeium.notes: Open-source disruptor; best for polyglot teams, students, budget-constrained startups

continue_dev.name: Continue.dev
continue_dev.description: Open-source code completion platform focused on self-hosted models
continue_dev.features: Local model support, IDE-agnostic, customizable completions, privacy-focused
continue_dev.adoption: Growing in privacy-conscious and on-premise-only enterprises
continue_dev.integrations: VS Code, JetBrains, custom IDE support
continue_dev.dx: High privacy, flexible model choice; requires infrastructure knowledge
continue_dev.notes: Best for privacy-first and self-hosted scenarios

rovo_dev.name: Rovo Dev (Atlassian)
rovo_dev.description: Terminal-centric AI automation for enterprise teams using Atlassian ecosystem
rovo_dev.features: CLI automation, Jira/Bitbucket/Confluence deep integration, agentic workflows, enterprise automation
rovo_dev.architecture: CLI-first, enterprise SaaS, Atlassian API integration
rovo_dev.adoption: Niche but growing in Atlassian-heavy enterprises; enterprise pricing model
rovo_dev.dx: Terminal-centric workflow; strong for DevOps/CI automation; not IDE-centric
rovo_dev.community_health: Backed by Atlassian; limited open community
rovo_dev.notes: Enterprise automation specialist; best for Atlassian-heavy teams

temporal.name: Temporal
temporal.description: Distributed workflow orchestration with ACID guarantees
temporal.features: ACID transactions, state persistence, error recovery, durable execution, DAG workflows
temporal.architecture: Distributed, database-backed state machine, horizontal scalability
temporal.adoption: High in data engineering and microservices; production workloads at Uber, others
temporal.compliance: Multi-region support, audit logs, data residency controls
temporal.integrations: Kubernetes, cloud databases, message queues, monitoring tools
temporal.dx: Minimal UI/UX; powerful but steep learning curve; excellent reliability
temporal.community_health: Strong community, active development, backed by TSV Capital
temporal.extensibility: High; activity system allows custom logic
temporal.notes: Industry standard for reliability; no human decision-making workflows

prefect.name: Prefect
prefect.description: Modern workflow orchestration with strong DX focus (Orion dashboard)
prefect.features: Intuitive UI (Orion), Python-first, error handling, scheduling, monitoring
prefect.architecture: Cloud-first, Python SDK, managed SaaS or self-hosted
prefect.adoption: Growing; popular with data engineering teams valuing UX
prefect.compliance: Prefect Cloud with SOC 2, data residency options
prefect.integrations: Python ecosystem, cloud providers, databases, scheduling
prefect.dx: Best-in-class UX; Orion dashboard is intuitive; good developer experience
prefect.notes: DX-focused alternative to Temporal; strong growth trajectory

dagster.name: Dagster
dagster.description: Data orchestration platform with strong lineage tracking
dagster.features: Data lineage, DAG definition, error recovery, scheduling, asset management
dagster.integrations: Python libraries, Kubernetes, dbt, cloud data warehouses
dagster.dx: Asset-centric paradigm; good for data lineage-aware teams
dagster.notes: Data lineage specialist; no human orchestration workflows

langchain.name: LangChain
langchain.description: Low-level LLM abstraction for chains, agents, and tool use
langchain.features: Chains (prompt + LLM + output parsing), agents (ReAct-style), tool use, memory management, 80K+ GitHub stars
langchain.architecture: Python/JavaScript library, model-agnostic, modular building blocks
langchain.adoption: Highest adoption in LLM ops space; 80K+ GitHub stars
langchain.compliance: Community-driven; data handling depends on LLM provider
langchain.integrations: 100+ LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, etc.), vector DBs, knowledge bases
langchain.dx: Low-level abstraction; powerful but requires understanding of prompt engineering
langchain.community_health: Excellent; large community, regular updates, strong ecosystem
langchain.notes: Market leader in LLM ops; focus on prompt chaining, not human workflows

llamaindex.name: LlamaIndex
llamaindex.features: Document indexing, RAG pipelines, vector DB integration, data connectors
llamaindex.architecture: Python library, RAG-focused, data source agnostic
llamaindex.adoption: Growing in knowledge-base and document-heavy use cases
llamaindex.compliance: Data connector framework; compliance depends on connectors
llamaindex.integrations: Vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate), LLMs, document sources
llamaindex.dx: High abstraction for RAG; easy to build knowledge-base systems

linear.name: Linear
linear.description: Modern issue tracking with gradual AI integration
linear.features: Issue tracking, project management, Slack integration, AI-powered summaries (beta), fast UI
linear.architecture: Cloud SaaS, React frontend, GraphQL API
linear.adoption: Popular with startups and product teams; $10-30K/mo pricing
linear.integrations: GitHub, Slack, Zapier, Notion, custom API
linear.dx: Fast, minimal UI; minimal AI features currently (beta stage)
linear.notes: Task management incumbent; lacks structured refinement workflows

github_projects.name: GitHub Projects + AI
github_projects.description: Native GitHub task management with emerging AI features
github_projects.features: Issue management, project boards, automation, GitHub Copilot integration, PR summaries
github_projects.architecture: GitHub-native, web-based, deeply integrated with GitHub
github_projects.adoption: High among GitHub-native teams; included in GitHub subscription
github_projects.dx: Familiar for GitHub-centric teams; AI features growing

aiconductor.name: AIConductor
aiconductor.description: Multi-stakeholder task orchestration with AI-assisted feature refinement
aiconductor.features: Batched stakeholder reviews (Product → Architect → UX → Security), multi-step task refinement (clarifications → AC → breakdown), real-time dashboard with WebSocket, MCP server protocol, feature refinement workflows, gap analysis, positioning research
aiconductor.architecture: MCP-native, TypeScript/React, SQLite + Express, real-time WebSocket updates, multi-repo support
aiconductor.adoption: Open-source; growing; purpose-built for AI development teams
aiconductor.compliance: Self-hosted, data residency control (local SQLite), audit trail via transitions
aiconductor.integrations: MCP protocol (Anthropic ecosystem), Claude AI, web search, PDF export, dashboard API
aiconductor.dx: Task-centric workflows, structured refinement loops, real-time visibility, batched role processing
aiconductor.extensibility: Very high; MCP-based, custom tools, extensible dashboard
aiconductor.notes: ONLY platform combining multi-stakeholder workflows + AI-assisted refinement + real-time dashboard + MCP protocol
